profile.headline: Engineering at Enzo Health
profile.summary:
I make it a personal goal to leave every workplace a better place and to leave every interaction having improved the relationship with that person.

I am a professional who works smart. I work efficiently and am dedicated to my work. I strive to bring value to the teams I work on by helping others when they run into blockers or need another set of eyes on something. At the same time I also am not afraid to ask for help so that I do not get stuck and put the team behind schedule. I like to broaden my vision and not get stuck doing what has always been done. 

I balance that dedication for work by being dedicated to my family. I work smart and efficiently so that I can spend time with my family and have fun living life. While, technology is a large part of my life and something I love to work with and implement, I also enjoy being outside cycling, swimming, playing frisbee, and other outdoor activities, I also enjoy reading and playing board games.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager and Senior Software Engineer
Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created a python script to automate server, database, codebase, and local web hosting setup, making a 2-hour process take 10 minutes, allowing my team and other software engineers spend more time solving problems and engineering new solutions rather than spending time setting up their environments
•	Engineered the ability to transfer content between Drupal, WordPress, File System, and Middleware Lingotek connectors with PHP, allowing our clients to easily move their translated assets
•	Auditing future client’s sites by setting up the server, database, codebase, and local web hosting and delivering the results and recommendations, building positive, trusting relationships with the clients
Manage a team of three, keeping our Drupal 7 connector stable and troubleshooting client-specific support needs so that the Lingotek Sales team can have confidence in selling the product my team maintains

positions.title: Consulting Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked on a team of 6 to design, build, test, and deploy a virtual Animal Shelter for the BARC Foundation
•	Designed and implemented Authentication for the web application so that users could log on and be authenticated with popular social media accounts and so that there was minimal upkeep for the client
•	Presented Final architecture and other major features of the web application in August to the client and to Pariveda with the other four interns

positions.title: Systems Analyst and Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Manage a team of three to determine and document requirements for the POS functionality, completing the initial phase of Design allowing the company to enter the beta phase before the end of the year
•	Writing and editing the requirements document with Use Case descriptions, End-to-end testing, UML documentation, and prototypes, in order to define the final product and ensure it is developed as expected

positions.title: Executive assistant and Project Mananger
positions.description:
•	Diagram new development which is projected to advance the deployment date and reduce bugs by eliminating non-functioning and un-wanted features, and forgetting wanted features; already advancing deployment by 50% 
•	Applied front end database manipulation (MAQL statements) to create a dashboard allowing the support team to provide better service to the company’s customers that increased customer satisfaction scores from 67.7% in July 2014 to 76.7% by April 2015
•	Evaluated Data with the Support manager to see where tickets left SLA and used MAQL statements to create reports and support roles which dropped the backlog of tickets from ~2000 open tickets in/out of SLA to maintaining ~200 open tickets within SLA, increasing the support team’s success in helping customers
•	Applied VBA to decrease the time spent on a report from 6 hours to 15 minutes, allowing the other executive assistants to take more tasks from the Executive team

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Selected as one of two assistants and organized the transition from 160 volunteer representatives to 260 over a six-month period and oriented the influx of representatives to accomplish their responsibilities
•	Developed and applied a plan to increase efficiency and effectiveness of the western region of Buenos Aires which increased the key indicators for the region from 63% to 70%

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
